name: npu_regs
desc: INT8 neural-network accelerator: frame writer to DDR, command processor (64-byte layer descriptors), 64 x 64 MAC array, decode of detections (golden model: ip/ai/npu/model/npu_model.py).

fields.name: AUTO
fields.desc: start a run on every frame the frame writer completes

fields.name: WRITE
fields.desc: frame writer on: every input frame (RGB888) to FRAME_ADDR, FRAME_STRIDE bytes per line

registers.name: CMD
registers.desc: write 1: start a run now (ignored while busy)

fields.name: FRAME
fields.desc: a frame was written since the last run started

registers.name: DESC_ADDR
registers.desc: DDR address of the first layer descriptor

registers.name: DET_ADDR
registers.desc: DDR address of the detection list (16 bytes per detection)

registers.name: DET_COUNT
registers.desc: detections written by the last run

registers.name: FRAME_ADDR
registers.desc: DDR address of the frame buffer (frame writer, INPUT operation)

registers.name: LB_STEP
registers.desc: letterbox: frame pixels per network input pixel, Q16 (bilinear scaling)

registers.name: LB_OFFSET
registers.desc: letterbox: top-left of the picture in the network input

registers.name: LB_SIZE
registers.desc: letterbox: picture size in the network input

registers.name: LB_INV
registers.desc: decode: frame pixels per network input pixel, Q16 (detections in frame pixels)

registers.name: LB2_STEP
registers.desc: second letterbox (INPUT / DECODE with descriptor flag BANK2: the low-resolution pass for large objects): as LB_STEP
